title: AgentEvent
description:
The agent event stream defined in SPEC 7.2. agentd emits these and api relays them over SSE with a monotonic id for Last-Event-ID resume.

Two rules this schema cannot express, which every decoder must honour:
  1. Unknown `type` values are ignored, not fatal (SPEC 7.2, 18). Objects      therefore permit additional properties: a newer producer must not      break an older consumer. Decode the envelope first, then the variant.
  2. usage.tick is advisory. Billing reads usage_events, never this stream.
